name: Boon of Tenkara
description:
The Boon of Tenkara manifests in only some of the children of Ikeda.

Roll a feat die. On a 6 or higher, you gain the following abilities:

  • You can move or levitate up to a gallon of water, cause small waves in a body of water, or stop or accelerate the flow of a small stream.

  • You may form water into a whip-like weapon with Reach: 5, dealing 1d4 damage on a hit.

  • You may move a water vessel in water at ¼ its Speed or increase its Speed by ¼ for up to 1 hour. You may strain yourself to continue this effect, spending Endurance equal to your BODY score for each additional hour.

Describe how you discovered that you possessed the Boon or how you discovered that you did not possess it.

improvements.name: Strengthened Boon
improvements.description:
If you already had the boon, it becomes stronger:

  • You can move or levitate up to 100 gallons of water, cause waves up to 10 ft tall in a body of water, or stop or accelerate the flow of a river no more than 50 ft wide.

  • You may form at least one gallon of water into a whip-like weapon with Reach: 10, dealing 1d6 damage on a hit.

  • You may move a water vessel in water at 1/2 its Speed or increase its Speed by 1/2 for up to 1 hour. You may strain yourself to continue this effect, spending Endurance equal to your BODY score for each additional hour.

  • Once per rest, you may spend an action to draw water around yourself and use it to levitate up to 10 ft above the ground or surface of water for up to 1 minute. While doing so, your Speed increases by 1/2.
